scope: Preserve existing formal outputs during HTML/PDF generation and pre-publication validation failures

finding.before: Formal HTML was written before PDF generation and source hash validation, so failed generation could overwrite prior outputs.
finding.after: Generate in temporary directories, validate source and read asset hashes, then replace formal outputs.

validation.failure_matrix: PDF exception or source drift, with existing or absent outputs; all preserve prior formal output state.
validation.success: Mock PDF writer observes unchanged prior outputs until publication; both outputs updated and temporary directories cleaned.
validation.real_cli: Subprocess main with partial PDF write then injected exception fails while preserving prior outputs and directory entries.

limits: Renderer remains PARTIAL; this is a bounded generation-failure review.
Two os.replace calls are individually atomic, not a pair transaction; publication failure may leave mixed versions and does not guarantee rollback.
New parent directories may remain; process kill or power loss can leave staging directories.
PDF writer is mocked; actual PDF engine, layout, visual result and crash durability are unverified.
No app, commit, push or release.
